input.free_text_description: The system operates in the recruitment, messaging domain. It serves API Consumer, Customer, User as its primary actors. The main business capabilities include company, facade, message. Core business data revolves around BaseEntity, BaseRepo, CompanyEntity, CompanyRepo. The system enforces access control and identity verification for protected operations.

user_stories.story: As a API Consumer, I want to send and receive messages, so that I can communicate with other users in real time.
As a API Consumer, I want to manage user accounts and profiles, so that user information stays current and accurate.
As a API Consumer, I want to manage company operations, so that the relevant business process is handled efficiently.
As a API Consumer, I want to manage facade operations, so that the relevant business process is handled efficiently.
As a API Consumer, I want to manage outside operations, so that the relevant business process is handled efficiently.
